title: How to spot a fake natty: suspicious muscular rendering & general complexion nastiness
summary: NH lists visual signs that a physique is enhanced beyond the usual size and vascularity arguments. His signs: an all-over reddish lobster complexion, muscle that looks shrink-wrapped and impossibly hard, overdeveloped traps and shoulders out of proportion with linked muscles, and inflated-looking bulks. He warns that jealous beginners often misjudge naturals.
claims: Visual cues are the low-bro approach to spotting PED users; arguments based on vascularity or size fail because naturals have those too
Beginners who are skinny and resentful think anyone big is on PEDs; you can be big and shredded naturally
Severe back acne appearing suddenly with rapid size gain suggests hormonal imbalance from PEDs, though naturals can have acne
Hair loss can signal androgen use but also happens naturally
PED users often have a reddish lobster body all over, linked to high blood pressure and hematocrit, even without sun or pump
Enhanced muscle sits right under the skin with no subcutaneous fat layer, because the drugs build muscle while shedding fat
Enhanced muscle looks impossibly hard from low intramuscular fat and water; a natural's flexed arm still looks somewhat soft
Traps and shoulders respond strongly to androgens because of receptor density, but big traps alone aren't proof
The giveaway is overdevelopment: naturals grow in a kinetic chain, so huge shoulders come with decent triceps, while enhanced lifters show isolated blown-up muscles
Massive biceps with tiny forearms is suspicious, since you can't really isolate the biceps
PED bulks on wet compounds look inflated, with a 3D shoulders-and-arms fullness from drug-driven water retention
Whether someone is natural isn't crucial, but you should know if the person you take advice from is on drugs
